project_type: FileForgeWorkbench (FFWB) -- a large Rust workspace (~69 crates, ~9700 tests) emulating a mainframe dataset/editor workbench; egui/eframe desktop shell plus many domain crates. RC.B.7 touches only the dataset stack crates.
language: Rust (edition per workspace). Strict ASCII in all .rs files.
build_system: Cargo workspace. Root Cargo.toml holds [workspace].members. Quirk: Kiro runs ONLY scoped `-p <crate>` checks, NEVER --workspace or `cargo gate` (those are the owner's manual full gate). Terminal harness shows a cosmetic `Exit Code -1`; trust the redirected log, not the exit code.
test_framework: cargo test (nextest for the owner's full gate). Scoped `cargo test -p <crate>` for the inner loop. TDD mandatory: failing test first (RED), minimal impl (GREEN). Every test carries `// Validates: Requirement X.Y`.
test_command: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-dscatalog -p ff-dsalloc"  (and separately: cargo test -p ff-governance-tests)
verification_instructions: Run EACH command via the clean pwsh7 wrapper, ONE command per invocation, redirect stdout+stderr to tools/logs/<name>.txt and READ THE LOG BACK before judging success (harness Exit Code -1 is cosmetic). Required set: (1) cargo fmt; (2) cargo check -p ff-dscatalog -p ff-dsalloc -p ff-governance-tests --all-targets; (3) cargo clippy -p ff-dscatalog -p ff-dsalloc -- -D warnings; (4) cargo test -p ff-dscatalog -p ff-dsalloc; (5) cargo test -p ff-governance-tests; (6) cargo check -p ff-desktop --all-targets (regression guard; no consumer of the reshaped outcomes); (7) cargo check -p ff-volume (no new dep); (8) read root Cargo.toml and confirm ff-vsam-services absent; (9) C:\tools\python\python.exe tools\python\check_line_limits.py (redirect+read). NEVER run --workspace or cargo gate -- hand off to the owner for the full gate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None for these crates. Do not commit tools/logs/ (git-ignored).
environment_constraints: Edits go DIRECTLY on branch main, left UNCOMMITTED for owner review -- do NOT commit or push. Do NOT run --workspace/cargo gate. Do NOT touch .worktrees/. Preserve the ACYCLIC DAG ff-idcams -> ff-dsalloc -> ff-dscatalog -> ff-volume -> ff-vfs; ff-volume gains NO new deps. Do NOT enter RC.B.8: no ff-idcams CODE repoint, no editor SAVE path change, no ff-dataset-catalog deletion. If any step seems to force an ff-idcams code change, STOP and report (send_message warning).
contribution_requirements: rust-standards.md: 400 non-test lines per .rs file (split tests to sibling _tests.rs before ~200 lines; put NEW code in NEW modules -- do NOT grow catalog.rs ~640 / esds.rs / sqlite_record.rs which are already >400). documentation.md: .rs files STRICT ASCII (box-drawing U+2500 and em dashes/curly quotes are violations) -- any comment separator region you edit must become ASCII `// === ... ===`. testing.md: TDD red-before-green, scoped checks only, then hand off the full gate to the owner. framework-conformance.md: build ON DatasetAccess + the single ff-vfs::StorageProvider seam + existing backends; add NO new backend and NO second dispatcher.
key_patterns: DatasetAccess is object-safe (`&self`, no generics, no Self-by-value; guarded by _assert_object_safe(&dyn DatasetAccess)). The single physical seam is Arc<dyn ff_vfs::StorageProvider> (BYTE-oriented: open->Vec<u8>, write(&[u8]); keyed/relative are only capability FLAGS, not methods). VSAM backends carry their OWN typed keyed/relative APIs (SqliteRecordProvider::read(key)/insert; SqliteRrdsProvider::read(rrn)/write; NativeEsdsProvider::append/read) reachable only by concrete type -- so FEAT-001 introduces an in-crate VsamBackend enum that owns them. VSAM is a CLUSTER ENTITY (VsamCluster/VsamType), NOT a Dsorg variant. Record = { key: Vec<u8>, data: Vec<u8> } (re-exported as crate::Record). DatasetError maps onto CatalogError/VolumeError/CodecError/VfsError; the NotYetWired variant is the current VSAM stub. ff-dsalloc depends on catalog ONLY through mockable traits (CatalogProvider/DatasetAllocator) -- NO rusqlite. RC.B.6 already made AllocationOutcome::Allocated carry a handle and added dsn_display_path() (Option A: panel shows DSN-derived path, locator opaque).

directory_structure: crates/ff-dscatalog/src/{dataset_access/,storage/,codecs/,vsam_service.rs,lib.rs} owns the catalog, backends, DatasetAccess and reconciled VsamService. crates/ff-dsalloc/src/{allocation.rs,catalog_bridge.rs,pipeline.rs,panel.rs,command.rs} is the JCL allocator front-half. crates/ff-governance-tests/{src/compliance.rs,tests/architecture_compliance.rs} enforces the dependency DAG. crates/ff-vsam-services (stub, to delete) and crates/ff-dataset-catalog (trait-only fixture, NOT deleted here) are DEPRECATED-FOR-MERGE. crates/ff-idcams depends on ff-dsalloc; keep out of its code. docs/ holds specs/TCR/status (documentation edits do not need the gate but still must be ASCII where .rs rules apply; .md allows box-drawing).
